description: Lieux et bâtiments à vocation publique is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Cet ensemble présente les lieux et bâtiments à vocation publique et leurs principaux attributs tels que leurs adresses et horaires ainsi que la disponibilité d'installations et de commodités, notamment en matière de services en accessibilité universelle. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Accessibilité universelle, Bâtiment, Lieux accessibles, Lieux publics, SCAEC. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
